findings.text: the third halted kind now requires "no attempt claim between the repair and the row", but on the very row the section names as its positive control the claim and the row fall inside the same second: run `r-20261023T012524464845-a-plan-write-refuses-the-bucket` has `status-repair.json` `repaired_at` 2026-10-23T12:14:30Z, its carried halted row at 12:14:49Z (`complete -> blocked`, no `status_repair` field, so a genuine pre-fix carried row), and `attempt-4.claim` with mtime 2026-10-23T12:14:49.398Z — nineteen seconds after the repair and inside the same second as the row. The stream records `observed_at` only to the second, so whether the claim is "between the repair and the row" depends on an observation instant no record preserves; read one way the control counts 1, the other way it reads 0 and the section's own rule fires ("A figure that reads zero on that window cannot see its mechanism")
